tasks.title: NotificationChannel abstraction + ChatwootChannel (SMS, live-tested)
tasks.notes: Chatwoot SMS channel is LIVE and tested. The full NotificationChannel abstraction (spec §5.2) — OutboundMessage/NotificationRecipient VOs (R15), label()/medium()/supports() interface — is what remains.

prep.what: Complete the NotificationChannel abstraction layer that wraps the already-live Chatwoot SMS channel per spec §5.2.
prep.understand: The Chatwoot SMS integration already works end-to-end. This task is about making it architecturally correct: wrapping it in the formal `NotificationChannel` interface with proper value objects and routing. Rule R15 mandates `OutboundMessage`/`NotificationRecipient` VOs. `ReminderDispatcher` must skip at claim-time for unsupported channels.
approach: Review spec §5.2 and rule R15 — note exactly what the interface contract requires (label, medium, supports methods).
Implement `OutboundMessage` and `NotificationRecipient` value objects under the existing notification namespace.
Add `label()`, `medium()`, `supports()` to the `NotificationChannel` interface and implement them in `ChatwootChannel`.
Update `ReminderDispatcher` to call `supports()` and skip unsupported channels at claim-time.
Run existing notification tests; add one test for `supports()` returning false for FB/IG/Telegram if not already covered.
resources: rule R15 in project rules (VO requirements)

tasks.title: Dashboard AR cluster + cashflow calendar
tasks.notes: AR cluster (dashboard receivables) is done. 'Cashflow calendar' shipped as compact upcoming-due LIST widget at Region C, NOT the full /cashflow month-grid that spec §6 describes. Decision needed: accept list as v1, or build the grid.

prep.what: Close the cashflow calendar gap — either build the /cashflow month-grid per spec §6, or formally accept the current upcoming-due list widget as v1.
prep.understand: Spec §6 describes a dedicated `/cashflow` route with a monthly grid showing inflows/outflows by date. What shipped is a compact upcoming-due card list in the dashboard sidebar. These are different UX patterns. Before coding anything: re-read spec §6 to decide if a list is acceptable or if a grid is required.
approach: Open spec §6 and compare the cashflow grid requirement against `upcoming-due-card.tsx` — list what's missing.
If the list is accepted as v1: update the task notes with the formal scope decision, close the gap entry, and mark done.
If the grid is required: scaffold a `/cashflow` Inertia page + month-grid component, reusing the AR data already exposed.
Wire the month-grid to pull invoice due-dates grouped by month and render inflow/outflow totals per day.
Run `npm run types:check` and existing dashboard tests.
resources: existing AR cluster components for data shape reference
InertiaJS routing — how other /dashboard sub-routes are wired

tasks.title: Add server/hosting provider model separate from domain registrar
tasks.notes: Gap found during AZ Agency legacy-domain migration: the system conflates domain registrar and server/hosting provider. These are separate relationships. Migration intentionally preserved registrar data only; hosting provider field is missing.

prep.what: Add a `hosting_provider` field (or FK model) to domains so registrar and hosting are tracked separately.
prep.understand: Right now a domain has one 'provider' field that mixes up who holds the domain registration (e.g. Namecheap, GoDaddy) and where the site is hosted (e.g. Hostinger, DigitalOcean). These can be different companies. The fix: separate them at the data model level.
approach: Find the current domain model and its provider field — check `app/Models/Domain.php` and related migrations.
Decide the shape: simple nullable string `hosting_provider`, or a FK to a shared Provider/Service model if one exists.
Write a migration to add the column (or new table). Keep it nullable — old records get null.
Update the domain form (create + edit views) and domain detail view to show the new field.
Run `php artisan migrate` locally, then `php artisan test` and `npm run types:check`.
resources: fin.azteam.cloud staging DB for manual verification
